```{r config}
tx <- list(
  seed = 2026L,
  min_docfreq = 5L,  # drop words in fewer paragraphs than this
  run_searchK = TRUE,  # TRUE once to choose K (slow)
  K_grid = seq(2, 40, 2),
  K = 12L,  # set from the searchK plots
  spline_df = 5L,  # flexibility of the year trend
  run_sensitivity = TRUE,  # TRUE once to test the merge settings
  sens_factors = c(0.75, 1.25),  # multiples of min_tokens and max_tokens
  n_words = 20L,  # words per topic shown to the codebook model
  n_examples = 5L,  # example paragraphs per topic shown to the codebook model
  n_draws = 25L,  # draws of topic shares behind each trend interval
  workers = 20L,
  use_openrouter = TRUE,  # FALSE at work
  steps = tibble::tribble(
    ~step, ~base_url_env, ~api_key_env, ~model,
    "codebook", "COMPASS_LARGE_URL", "COMPASS_LARGE_KEY", "LARGE-MODEL"))

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(stm); library(splines); library(viridis)
  library(tidyverse)  # tidyverse last so its verbs win
})
theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 12))
set.seed(tx$seed)
source("../topics_source.R")  # shared functions, one folder up
if (isTRUE(tx$use_openrouter)) source("../llm_openrouter.R")
```

# Input

```{r input}
#| results: asis
para_in <- p_out("paragraphs.csv")
paragraphs <- readr::read_csv(para_in, show_col_types = FALSE,
                              col_types = readr::cols(id = "c", para_uid = "c"))
writeLines(glue::glue("{nrow(paragraphs)} paragraph units from \\
  {dplyr::n_distinct(paragraphs$id)} comments."))
```

# Document-term matrix

Words are lowercased and kept only if purely alphabetic. Stopwords and month and weekday names are removed; temporal words would let topics encode the year directly. Words in fewer than `r tx$min_docfreq` paragraphs are dropped.

```{r dtm}
s <- stm_setup(paragraphs, tx$min_docfreq, tx$spline_df)
glue::glue("{length(s$documents)} paragraphs, {length(s$vocab)} words")
```

# Choosing K

Take the smallest K where held-out likelihood has flattened and residual dispersion has stopped falling, then break ties on coherence and exclusivity. If the best values sit at the edge of the grid, widen it.

```{r searchK}
if (isTRUE(tx$run_searchK)) {
  cached(p_out("searchK.parquet"), para_in, search_k(s, tx$K_grid, tx$seed, tx$workers)) |>
    plot_search_k()
} else glue::glue("searchK skipped; K = {tx$K}")
```

# Structural topic model

Year enters topic prevalence as a spline, so each topic's share can rise and fall. Spectral initialization makes the fit reproducible. The fit is saved as `stm_fit.rds` and reloaded later; delete it to refit.

```{r stm-fit}
stm_fit <- cached(p_out("stm_fit.rds"), para_in, fit_stm(s, tx$K))
K <- ncol(stm_fit$theta)
if (K != tx$K) stop("stm_fit.rds has K = ", K, " but tx$K = ", tx$K,
                    ". Delete stm_fit.rds, then re-render.")
```

# Assigning paragraphs to topics

Each paragraph is assigned its most likely topic. **Entropy R²** (0 to 1) says how sharply paragraphs sort into topics overall; **AvePP** is the average topic share among a topic's own paragraphs, with about 0.7 the usual floor. Both fall as units get longer, so use them to compare topics within a fit, not to choose the unit size.

```{r modal}
#| results: asis
tables <- topic_tables(stm_fit, s$meta,
                       c("para_uid", "id", "para_id", "Year", "n_tokens", "text"), tx$n_words)
theta_in <- p_out("paragraph_theta.csv")
readr::write_csv(tables$paragraph_theta, theta_in)
readr::write_csv(tables$topic_summary, p_out("topic_summary.csv"))

writeLines(glue::glue("Entropy R2 = {round(tables$entropy_r2, 3)}. Topics with AvePP \\
  under 0.7: {sum(tables$topic_summary$avepp < 0.7, na.rm = TRUE)} of {K}."))
tables$topic_summary |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(prevalence)) |>
  dplyr::select(topic, prevalence, n_paras, avepp) |>
  tbl_paged(caption = "Topics by prevalence.")
```

# Do the merge settings drive the topics?

The paragraph units are rebuilt at `r str_c(tx$sens_factors, collapse = " and ")` times `min_tokens` and `max_tokens` from the saved embeddings (no API calls), and the model is refit at the same K with the same year spline. Each baseline topic is matched to its closest topic in each refit by the cosine of their word distributions. A topic with a low cosine exists only at one way of cutting the text and deserves caution.

```{r sensitivity}
#| results: asis
if (isTRUE(tx$run_sensitivity)) {
  sens_in <- p_out(c("paragraphs.csv", "blocks.parquet", "embeddings.parquet",
                     "merge_settings.parquet"))
  blocks <- arrow::read_parquet(sens_in[2])
  E <- emb_matrix(blocks, arrow::read_parquet(sens_in[3]))
  ms <- arrow::read_parquet(sens_in[4])
  refit <- function(f) {
    p <- link_corpus(blocks, E, ms$min_tokens * f, ms$max_tokens * f, ms$min_sim) |>
      dplyr::filter(keep)
    alt <- stm_setup(p, tx$min_docfreq, tx$spline_df)
    # same spline knots as the baseline, so only the cut of the text differs
    alt$meta[colnames(s$bs)] <- stats::predict(s$bs, newx = alt$meta$Year)
    match_topics(beta_matrix(stm_fit), beta_matrix(fit_stm(alt, K))) |>
      dplyr::mutate(factor = f, paragraphs = length(alt$documents))
  }
  sens_tbl <- cached(p_out("sensitivity.parquet"), sens_in,
                     purrr::list_rbind(purrr::map(tx$sens_factors, refit)))
  if (max(sens_tbl$topic) != K)
    stop("sensitivity.parquet was built at another K. Delete it and re-render.")
  sens_tbl |>
    dplyr::group_by(factor) |>
    dplyr::summarise(paragraphs = dplyr::first(paragraphs),
                     median_cosine = stats::median(cosine), lowest_cosine = min(cosine)) |>
    tbl_paged(caption = "Matched topic cosine against the baseline fit.")
  sens_tbl |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = topic, names_from = factor, values_from = cosine,
                       names_prefix = "x") |>
    tbl_paged(caption = "Matched cosine per topic.")
} else writeLines("Sensitivity test skipped (tx$run_sensitivity = FALSE).")
```

# Topic codebook

One call per topic, in parallel, with the larger model. Each call sees only that topic's `r tx$n_words` most distinctive (FREX) and most probable words and its `r tx$n_examples` most typical paragraphs. It drafts a label, a one-sentence description, and a proposition for the stance app. If `topic_codebook.csv` exists it is read, not redrafted, so your edits survive. Delete it to redraft.

```{r codebook}
#| results: asis
codebook <- draft_codebook(p_out("topic_codebook.csv"), theta_in, tables, "public comments",
                           tx$steps, tx$use_openrouter, tx$n_examples)
dup <- codebook |> dplyr::add_count(label) |> dplyr::filter(n > 1, !is.na(label))
if (nrow(dup)) writeLines(glue::glue("**Duplicate labels to fix:** \\
  {str_c('topic ', dup$topic, ' (', dup$label, ')', collapse = ', ')}."))
codebook |>
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(tables$topic_summary, topic, frex), by = "topic") |>
  dplyr::mutate(title = str_c("Topic ", topic, ": ", label)) |>
  tbl_records("title", c("description", "proposition", "frex"),
              caption = "Topic codebook. Edit the CSV; nothing redrafts it.")
```

# Prevalence over time

For each topic, its share of each paragraph is regressed on the year spline with a fractional logit (Papke and Wooldridge 1996), so every estimated share stays between 0 and 1. The model is refit on `r tx$n_draws` draws of the topic shares and the results combined, so the 95 percent intervals include the topic model's own uncertainty and the clustering of paragraphs within a comment.

```{r effects}
trends <- topic_trends(stm_fit, s, tx$n_draws, tx$seed, s$meta$id)
readr::write_csv(trends, p_out("topic_trends.csv"))
```

```{r trend-plots}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-cap: "Expected topic share by year with 95 percent intervals, nine topics per page, most prevalent first."
trends |>
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(codebook, topic, label), by = "topic") |>
  dplyr::left_join(dplyr::select(tables$topic_summary, topic, prevalence), by = "topic") |>
  plot_trends()
```

```{r handoff}
#| results: asis
writeLines(glue::glue("Wrote paragraph_theta.csv, topic_summary.csv, topic_codebook.csv, \\
  topic_trends.csv and stm_fit.rds to topics/comments/outputs/."))
```
